name: Tenant and lease management
description: The system must support tenant records, lease terms, occupancy status, and key obligations so property information remains consistent and up to date.
evidenceCriteria: Developer asks about tenant records or lease terms.
Developer mentions occupancy or unit status.
Developer discusses how property obligations are tracked.

name: Property and unit portfolio management
description: The business needs a way to manage multiple units or properties with consistent recordkeeping and visibility across the portfolio.
evidenceCriteria: Developer asks about multiple properties or units.
Developer mentions centralized visibility across the portfolio.
Developer discusses location-level management or comparison.

name: Maintenance tracking and work orders
description: The system must support maintenance requests, work orders, tracking status, and vendor coordination to keep issues moving.
evidenceCriteria: Developer asks about maintenance requests or work orders.
Developer mentions repairs or issue tracking.
Developer discusses service status or vendor relationships.

name: Rent collection and payment reconciliation
description: The solution must support rent collection, arrears tracking, payment recording, and reconciliation for accurate cash flow management.
evidenceCriteria: Developer asks about rent or payment collection.
Developer mentions late payments or reconciliation.
Developer discusses monthly financial tracking.

name: Inspection and compliance workflow
description: The property manager may need inspections, document tracking, and compliance reminders to keep properties and leases in order.
evidenceCriteria: Developer asks about inspections or compliance checks.
Developer mentions documents or renewals.
Developer discusses regulatory or policy tracking.

name: Reporting and portfolio visibility
description: The business needs reporting on occupancy, rent collection, maintenance load, and operational KPIs to manage the portfolio effectively.
evidenceCriteria: Developer asks about dashboards or business reporting.
Developer mentions occupancy, revenue, or maintenance trends.
Developer discusses management visibility across properties.

name: Vendor and contractor coordination
description: The system may need vendor records, contractor communication, and work-order assignment to keep maintenance and upkeep organized.
evidenceCriteria: Developer asks about vendors or contractors.
Developer mentions service coordination or external providers.
Developer discusses contractors or service schedules.

name: Operational constraints and old-system realities
description: The solution must fit real operational constraints such as existing accounting tools, staff capacity, and the need for low-friction daily use.
evidenceCriteria: Developer asks about existing tools or legacy systems.
Developer mentions staff adoption or minimal process disruption.
Developer discusses operational realities that affect daily management.

name: Communication and tenant service workflow
description: The business may need communication with tenants about rent, maintenance, or notices while keeping issues visible and actioned.
evidenceCriteria: Developer asks about tenant communication or notices.
Developer mentions reminders or issue updates.
Developer discusses service communication workflows.
